rust_summary: A server player's attack strength was reset by a punch (`native_player_attack_cooldown_reset`).
doc_summary: A server player's main-hand punch swing and attack-strength reset have happened: `native_player_attack_cooldown_reset(player, name)`. Helpers looking up the player through `self.lan` may find nothing during a guest packet. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_attack_cooldown_reset@.
